## Attributes

Attributes defined in the `zos` namespace. Application developers are encouraged to reuse existing attributes; see these [naming recommendations](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/naming/#recommendations-for-application-developers) regarding attribute selection and naming for custom use cases.

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="zos-smf-id">`zos.smf.id`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The System Management Facilities (SMF) identifier that uniquely identifies a z/OS system within a sysplex or standalone mainframe environment. [1] | `SYS1`; `PROD1`; `TEST2` |
| <a id="zos-sysplex-name">`zos.sysplex.name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The name of the z/OS systems complex (SYSPLEX) to which this z/OS system belongs. [2] | `SYSPLEX1`; `PRODPLEX` |

**[1] `zos.smf.id`:** The SMF system identifier (SMFID) is a 1-4 character alphanumeric name set at IPL time via the SMFPRMxx parmlib member. It is used throughout z/OS for system identification in SMF records, RMF reports, and sysplex routing.

**[2] `zos.sysplex.name`:** A sysplex is a cluster of z/OS systems that cooperate using the coupling facility (CF) for shared data and workload management. The sysplex name is defined in the COUPLExx parmlib member. In distributed systems terms, a sysplex is analogous to a high-availability cluster.
